title: Named data for exact system evaluation normalization
statement: The actual scalar restriction functor on strict systems, its exact restriction/evaluation identification, the chosen normalized singleton comparison and its adjunction conjugate, ordinary and derived exact-square mates, their resolution-unit normalization predicate, and the structure of normalized ordinary scalar/transition squares.
